bullets.text: In Thiruvallur, a gas pipeline broke causing a major gas leak, and the office should monitor emergency response and fire safety measures.
In Thiruvallur, angry residents blocked the Chennai-Tirupati road near Periyapalayam to protest a five-hour power cut, and the office should coordinate with TNEB to restore stable supply.
In Avadi, ITI students brutally attacked a state bus conductor for stopping them from hanging on the footboard, and the office should track police action against the accused.

PMK leader Anbumani Ramadoss raised allegations regarding a direct intervention by a senior state official in the Pallikaranai wetland controversy, and the office should monitor the political fallout.
Motorists faced severe traffic congestion on the Velachery 100 Feet Road, and the office should coordinate with traffic police to ease movement.
In Thiruvallur district, Deepavali fireworks caused 81 cases of vision loss, showing an increase from previous years, and the office should review safety awareness campaigns.
In Ambattur DTP Colony, a sudden pit formed on the road, prompting water board workers to begin repair work, and the office should oversee the swift restoration of the road.
The CMWSSB invited bids to prepare a detailed project report for a 400 million MLD SWRO desalination plant at Minjur, and the office should track the project's progress.

Tamil Nadu partnered with IIT Madras to launch a new artificial intelligence data center through an MoU signed by IITM Pravartak, and the office should support the establishment of this infrastructure.
Vultr launched a 20-megawatt AI supercompute cluster in Chennai powered by over 10,000 AMD GPUs and extended cloud credits to startups, and the office should monitor tech ecosystem growth.
CERT-In issued a critical alert regarding Crafty Falcon AI-driven cyberattacks targeting India's financial sector, and the office should advise local institutions to strengthen cyber defenses.
Union Minister L. Murugan responded to questions regarding whether opposition parties are trying to bargain with TVK MLAs, and the office should monitor political developments.
PMK leader Anbumani Ramadoss publicly questioned whether Chief Minister Vijay can deliver good governance with DMK officials, and the office should note the political criticism.

Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay inaugurated over 600 newly constructed housing units worth 1,003 crore rupees across five locations in Chennai via video conference, and the office should track housing beneficiary allocations.
